_note: Do NOT hardcode region groups and do not invent labels. To resolve a population request, FILTER the population catalog injected at runtime and output its exact `population` display labels. This file is only vocabulary for that filter; every region is treated the same. If a filter is ambiguous or matches nothing, ask.

notes.labels: select_populations needs the exact `population` display label, not an acronym. Map an acronym or synonym the user types to the catalog label (e.g. YRI -> Yoruba-1KGP, 'Han Chinese' -> Beijing Han / Southern Han) before emitting it.
notes.ancient: AADR labels encode region and age, e.g. 'aDNA West EUR 5-6 kya'. Filter these for ancient / aDNA requests.
notes.duplicate_names: A -1KGP suffix distinguishes a 1KGP population from an HGDP population of the same name (HGDP 'Yoruba' vs 1KGP 'Yoruba-1KGP'). If the user is not specific, ask which.
notes.no_latlon: Do not infer a population's region from latitude/longitude; use the catalog. If region is unknown or the match is ambiguous, ask.
